changes.title: Jason Arday, ex-Cambridge professor accused of plagiarism, found dead week after resigning
changes.summary: Former Cambridge professor Jason Arday was found dead at his London home on Friday, one week after he resigned from his position after accusations of plagiarism.

changes.title: Jason Arday, youngest Black professor at Cambridge, found dead at 41 after resignation
changes.summary: A British sociologist who resigned last week from the University of Cambridge following weeks of public accusations of plagiarism and media scrutiny was found dead Friday.

changes.title: Jason Arday found dead after resigning from Cambridge over plagiarism claims
changes.summary: Academic was pronounced dead at his home in south London after police called to address after 3pm on Friday Jason Arday, the black academic who resigned last week as a professor at the University of Cambridge , has been found dead at his home in south London. The Metropolitan police said officers were called to Arday’s.

changes.title: Jason Arday, Cambridge Professor Accused of Plagiarism, Reported Dead
changes.summary: The British police said a man had been found dead at a home linked to Mr. Arday, who resigned after the university announced an investigation into allegations of plagiarism and fabrication.
